The system of crustal faults of the pre-volcanic basement is represented in Fig. 2(a) after Skdulescu (1984). This system was probably tectonically active until Sarmatian and it is covered by the volcanic rocks and coeval sedimentary deposits. The volcanic activity took place during Late Miocene- Pliocene Period and had three main stages: (1) rhyolite- dacite tuffs and lava flows; (2) a succession of pyroxene- andesite and quartz-andesite strato volcanoes and lava flows; (3) pyroxene andesites and basaltic andesites forming strato volcanoes, which reach the collapse caldera stage (GiugcB et al. 1973).
